escalations.summary: Passenger on booking AER-9L5D2R disputes the recorded cause of AK808. The operational record shows WEATHER; the passenger's account points to CREW. They quote: 'The woman at the gate told us directly that it was because the crew had not turned up. She said it twice'. Feed detail: Freezing fog at EDI, RVR below operating minima. Cancellation decision taken 16:55Z. Operating crew were on stand and within duty hours at the time of the decision; crew availability was not a factor.
escalations.requested_decision: Review the recorded cause and confirm or amend it.
escalations.recommendation: S3.1 requires the case to proceed on the operational record and the discrepancy to be stated plainly to the passenger, which the reply does. A representative may not amend a cause code (S12.1, S16), so the entitlement has been assessed on the recorded cause of WEATHER.
